description: A net qualified disaster loss raises the standard deduction; for the AMT only the standard deduction before the increase is added back (2025 Form 6251 instructions, lines 2a and 3). Single 2025: wages $100,000, qualified disaster loss $20,000, ISO spread $200,000. Deduction $15,750 + $20,000 = $35,750; taxable income $64,250, regular tax $9,055. AMTI $64,250 + $15,750 + $200,000 = $280,000; line 6 $191,900 × 26% = $49,894 → AMT $40,839. (Treating the return as itemizing added back $0 and gave AMTI $264,250.)
